section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1967
title: 2 A comparison of figures for 1966 and 1967 indicates that the incidence of accidental deaths during 1967 increased by 4·2% over 1966 while the growth rate of population and volume of accidental deaths per one lakh of population increased by 2·4% and 0·8% respectively. Table 2 presents the relevant comparative statistics. TABLE--2
